description:
The sales clerks in a bank can use their software frontend to receive the credit-scoring for a certain customer. 
This starts a process in the banking system which communicates with the agency in the background. 
This process sends a scoring request to the agency right after the beginning. 
Then, the Agency does a first quick scoring (level 1). 
This will often lead to an immediate result which is then returned directly to the banking system within seconds. 
The banking process presents the result to the clerk sitting at the frontend. 
Sometimes the scoring cannot be determined immediately and takes longer. 
In this case the agency informs the banking process of the delay and then starts the level 2 scoring (which can take up to a couple of minutes). 
After the scoring result is determined, the information is sent back to the banking process. 
The banking process displays a message to the clerk when he receives information about the delay to check again later. 
As soon as the result arrives, it can be seen at the frontend.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_CreditScoring"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/credit-scoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringDelay" name="Scoring delay"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringResult" name="Scoring result"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Bank" processRef="Process_Bank"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Request" name="Scoring request" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="Start_AgencyRequest" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Delay" name="Scoring delay" sourceRef="Task_SendDelay" targetRef="Catch_Delay" messageRef="Message_ScoringDelay"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Result" name="Scoring result" sourceRef="Task_SendResult" targetRef="Catch_Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Bank" name="Banking process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Bank">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Clerk" name="Sales clerk">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Bank</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RequestScoring</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DisplayDelay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DisplayResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Bank</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_BankingSystem" name="Banking system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaitForAgency</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_ImmediateResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_Delay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_Result</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_JoinResults</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Bank" name="Clerk requests credit scoring"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RequestScoring" name="Request credit scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequest" name="Send scoring request" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForAgency" name="Wait for agency response" eventGatewayType="Exclusive" instantiate="false"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate scoring result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_ImmediateResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Delay" name="Receive scoring delay">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_Delay" messageRef="Message_ScoringDelay"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_DisplayDelay" name="Display delay message"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Result" name="Receive scoring result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_JoinResults" name="Join result paths"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_DisplayResult" name="Display scoring result"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Bank" name="Result displayed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_1" sourceRef="Start_Bank" targetRef="Task_RequestScoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_2" sourceRef="Task_RequestScoring" targetRef="Task_SendRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_3" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForAgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_4" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgency" targetRef="Catch_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_5" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgency" targetRef="Catch_Delay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_6" sourceRef="Catch_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Gateway_JoinResults"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_7" sourceRef="Catch_Delay" targetRef="Task_DisplayDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_8" sourceRef="Task_DisplayDelay" targetRef="Catch_Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_9" sourceRef="Catch_Result" targetRef="Gateway_JoinResults"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_10" sourceRef="Gateway_JoinResults" targetRef="Task_DisplayResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_11" sourceRef="Task_DisplayResult" targetRef="End_Bank"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Agency scoring process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Agency">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Agency" name="Agency">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_AgencyRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Level1Scoring</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ImmediateResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendDelay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Level2Scoring</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_JoinAgencyPaths</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Agency</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_AgencyRequest" name="Receive scoring request">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_AgencyRequest" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level1Scoring" name="Perform level 1 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ImmediateResult" name="Result available immediately?" default="Flow_Agency_Delayed"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDelay" name="Inform bank of delay" messageRef="Message_ScoringDelay"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_JoinAgencyPaths" name="Join scoring paths"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendResult" name="Send scoring result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Agency" name="Scoring result sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_1" sourceRef="Start_AgencyRequest" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_2" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_Immediate" name="Immediate result" sourceRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Gateway_JoinAgencyPaths">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">resultAvailableImmediately</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_Delayed" name="Scoring takes longer" sourceRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_SendDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_4" sourceRef="Task_SendDelay" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_5" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_JoinAgencyPaths"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_6" sourceRef="Gateway_JoinAgencyPaths" targetRef="Task_SendResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_7" sourceRef="Task_SendResult" targetRef="End_Agency"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
